summary:
Implementation plan to fix the attendance metric in the hero section:
- Identifies the root cause where a falsy check on 0 Sunday attendances triggered a hardcoded '98.5%' fallback.
- Updates the metric evaluation to strictly read real database numbers (including 0) using compact number formatting.
- Ensures all 4 live telemetry metrics (churches, members, check-ins, attendance) reliably reflect live PostgreSQL data without percentage confusion.
